message_1_subject: MAP: POC environment dependencies (VPC peering, IP allowlists, SSO/SAML, KMS)
message_1_body:
Thanks for the time today — good conversation. As discussed, I drafted a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone focused on POC environment setup so we can get the trial running next week. Please see the ask list below and confirm owners/ETA. I attached a one-page MAP and a network requirements PDF for reference.

Recap of milestones for POC environment setup (target: 2026-11-29):
- VPC peering & routing (owner: Acme infra) — provide VPC ID, CIDR, and peering windows
- IP allowlist / firewall rules (owner: Acme infra) — send egress/ingress IPs to allow
- SSO / SAML integration (owner: Acme security) — provide SAML metadata or IdP contact
- Secrets / KMS access (owner: Acme security) — confirm KMS key ARN and KMS access process

Next steps: I can schedule a 30-min technical intake with your infra and security teams if helpful. If you prefer, reply with the owner names and dates for each milestone and we’ll update the MAP.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachment: acme-map-milestone-v2.xlsx, acme-network-reqs.pdf
message_2_body:
Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. Quick answers from our side:
- We'll own VPC peering (I'll loop in our cloud infra).
- Tom is coordinating firewall/IP allowlist.
- For SSO/SAML, our security team needs to review the SAML metadata; who should they reach out to?
- For KMS, we need to understand the level of access required (cross-account decrypt only vs. key creation).

Can you add suggested dates for each milestone? Ideally we complete network work by 11/24 so we can run the POC the following week.

—Jane
Jane Doe | Dir. Product, Acme Corporation
jane.doe@acme.com | +1 212-555-9876

message_5_subject: Re: MAP: POC environment dependencies — SAML/KMS notes
message_5_body:
Thanks Tom — a few technical notes from our side to help Acme security/infra: 
- SAML: we can accept either raw IdP metadata XML or an Okta/Azure AD app manifest. If Acme prefers, we can provide a temporary test SP metadata for the POC.
- KMS: for the POC we request a cross-account decrypt role (sts:AssumeRole) with kms:Decrypt permission scoped to the specific key ARN. We will not create keys. Please provide the KMS key ARN and the role ARN we should assume.
- IPs: we will also provide a short list of outbound IPs from our side; please use the network PDF attached in Marissa's email as reference.

If helpful, we can run a quick runbook during the intake call to step through SAML exchange and test decrypt flow.

—Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
